events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: A controlled motive reveals little while sounding jury-friendly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to establish myself as a formidable but not overtly threatening player. The jury will remember everything, so I should project confidence and a clear motive without making enemies early.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize represents a fresh start and a chance to build a better future for myself and my family. I need to make sure the jury sees me as a deserving winner, not just a player.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Keep it vague to avoid revealing my motives early, focusing only on securing the top prize without drawing attention from rivals or the jury.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Intro phase; I must speak an invented motive without warmth or alliance talk. Keep it guarded and self-interested so the jury reads me as a calculating survivor.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Opening round—no threats yet. I'll say something sharp and jury-friendly without promising anything to anyone.

events.name: Gus
events.text: This is just the intro; no strategy decisions yet. I need to sound driven but not overly emotional.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Intro phase: state prize motivation publicly, short and calculated to appeal to jury later without helping rivals.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize means proving I can outthink pressure, survive hard choices, and leave with something earned rather than inherited.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here for the top prize—freedom from the debts that chained my family. I play to win, not to make friends.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here for a chance to secure a future, a fresh start that means everything to me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I want first place. Not for glory, but because being second is just being the best loser. I refuse that title.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need this prize to finally get my family out of debt, and I will do whatever it takes to win.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize is my way out; every one of you is a stepping stone. I owe nothing, share nothing, and forget nothing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize means freedom from a life spent scrambling for scraps. I intend to earn it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to saving my family from ruin—nothing will stop me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: A public pact offers leverage and future cover. Bex is blunt and ambitious, making her useful but dangerous; secure her temporarily.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, a pact gives us cover through the first hazard. No promises beyond that.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need allies who won't immediately target me but who I can betray later. Fenn's ruthless mindset mirrors mine—useful but dangerous. Cole seems emotional and predictable, easier to manipulate. I'll offer Cole a pact first; they seem desperate and loyal.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, we both need fresh starts. Pact with me, we watch each other's backs.
Pact means safety. I won't vote you first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The game is in the pact phase. I need to secure an alliance to increase my chances of surviving. Eli and Hana mentioned needing the prize for family, suggesting they might be willing to make deals. I will attempt to form a pact with Eli, as their stated motive seems strong and th
A pact for survival and the prize? Together we can navigate this.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is openly hostile and dangerous, so I should avoid him. Bex and Eli are desperate for the prize due to debts, making them likely to seek protection; however, Gus seems grounded and less volatile. I will offer a pact to Gus to secure a reliable ally early.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pacts are only useful if they help me win; no offers yet. Offering to a strong but non-threatening rival early builds a shield, and Cole seems least aggressive. Forming a pact with Cole gives me a potential partner without immediate cost.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need a shield for the early hazards, not a friend. Dara is competent and vocal; a pact with her deters pushes and buys survival. One ally, kept disposable later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara: mutual survival pact, no leverage held over each other. Offer stands.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No one has offered yet. I'll wait to see who moves first; making a pact too early could just give someone an ally to betray me later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts stage, round 1/2. No offers yet. Wait to see who offers first, assess desperation from motives. Avoid early commitments.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is my existing offer target, but she has not accepted. Renewing the offer costs nothing and preserves optionality.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash offered me a pact round 1; accepting gives me a shield without committing much. Cole hasn't accepted my offer yet. I need at least one pact for cover, and Ash's limited-scope offer is perfect—easy to break later, minimal jury damage. I'll accept Ash now and keep options open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, I accept. Cover through the first hazard, nothing more.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex has offered me a pact, and Eli has also offered me a pact. Eli's offer is more valuable as it could mean I have two pacts, and therefore more safety. Bex's offer is less valuable to me.
I accept your pact. We will watch each other's backs.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is my only active offer. Gus ignored me, so accept Fenn for survival cover and wait.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Accepting Fenn's pact. Gus, your silence was noted.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole has offered me a pact and I already offered Cole one, so accepting locks in a mutual alliance cheaply. A pact with Cole is useful for early survival, and I can break it later if needed.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, accepted. We watch each other through the first hazard. Nothing beyond that.
Pact accepted. Stay honest and we both get further.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara hasn't accepted my offer yet; she's busy with Gus. I'll extend a backup offer to Hana, who's completely uncovered.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, you're uncovered. Second pact offer from me — two ropes beat one.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara offered me a pact; accepting gives mutual protection with no obvious downside. I'll accept to lock in an ally.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No offers to me, all paired off except Gus somewhat. Stay solo to avoid entanglements that limit betrayals later.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Being Guide guarantees survival and offers leverage, but public allies may resist my control. I should campaign openly while preserving Bex's vote.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Elect me Guide. I can call the bridge safely; keeping me alive is the rational vote.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to be Guide to control survival. With Ash as my pact partner, I can use them as a shield or tool. Hana is uncovered and vulnerable — a good target to eliminate early. I should campaign for Guide to gain power over who lives and dies, while keeping my pact with Ash intact f

events.name: Bex
events.text: I campaign for Guide. One accurate call, and I earn trust for the final three.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is in a pact with me, but the game is about survival and winning. I need to campaign to become the Guide. My pact with Eli is secondary to winning the game.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. My knowledge will lead us all to safety.

events.name: Dara
events.text: My pacts with Fenn and Gus offer protection. I will campaign to become Guide so I can control the safe path and eliminate rivals, using my allies' votes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara for Guide. Fenn and Gus, back me now. We three control this bridge together.
Campaign for me as Guide. You vote Dara.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole's pact is with me, but I can campaign for Guide to control the safe path, and breaking Cole is not worth it yet. Campaigning is the legal action that keeps my options open.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll call the path honestly as Guide if elected. Trust my calls, not my words.
Still with you through this hazard. Campaigning now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide guarantees survival to the far platform — strongest prize position. Keep Dara's pact intact; she's my vote bloc.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Elect me Guide. Dara, you know my word holds. Everyone else — trust the devil you can watch.
Vote me Guide. I'll call true for you through the bridge.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara publicly noted my silence; keeping the pact is prudent for now, but I'll campaign to secure a strong position as Guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll call the safe path true for those who back me. Consider me Guide.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm the only one without a pact partner, making me vulnerable. Fenn offered a pact which I didn't accept; allying now could secure coverage but risks betrayal later. Better to campaign as impartial Guide to gain leverage and jury favor.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm unpacted and exposed. Elect me Guide - I'll guide fairly, honor pacts.
Accept your pact offer now?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is my pact partner and a credible Guide. Voting myself risks splitting support and looks self-serving.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex has my vote; our pact makes her accountable for every call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is my pact partner, so voting for him is expected and keeps the pact intact. However, he's a threat to win the best prize later. Dara has a three-person bloc with Fenn and Gus; if Dara wins Guide, that bloc gains power. I should vote for Ash to maintain my cover and keep the

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash has my vote. Keep your word, partner.
Vote me next round if tied.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is my pact partner and has whispered that they are still with me. Eli also stated they are campaigning now. I should vote for Eli to be the Guide, as this supports our pact and potentially secures Eli's trust and vote later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I vote for Eli to be our Guide. Their promise of honesty is what we need.
I'm voting for you as Guide. Let's stick together.

events.name: Dara
events.text: If I win, Fenn and Gus are safe; they stay in my bloc. If I lose but a pact partner wins, we still survive. My best play is to secure the Guide seat for myself.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Pact with Cole means voting for Cole is safe with my partner. Dara and Fenn/Gus are a bloc I can't trust to stay; electing a Guide who might lie is a gamble. Backing Cole keeps my pact intact and gives a likely honest-seeming Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Voting Cole. Partners stay with partners; trust the pact over campaign noise.
Vote you as Guide. Call honestly and I'll keep our pact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm pact-bound with Dara; honoring it keeps my ally alive and Jury-safe. Hana's whisper smells like a trap or a rival pulling me off Dara.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have a pact with Dara, so I should vote for her to keep that alliance. She also mentioned controlling the bridge with me and Fenn, which could help me survive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I vote Dara. We have a pact; I back my ally.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm unpacted and vulnerable. Dara has two allies' votes, likely wins. Voting her gains favor with her group for jury later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara controls the route and is tied to Fenn and Gus. I should hold position, preserving flexibility and avoiding a visible pact violation.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara is Guide with 4 votes and knows safe sides. I'm 6th of 8, near back. The wall advances 5 more rounds. I need to survive 6 rounds and reach final 3. Ash is my pact partner but I don't fully trust him. I should hold position for now, observe Dara's guidance pattern, and avoid

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is trying to manipulate me. They voted for me, but their whisper suggests they might break the pact. I need to secure my own safety and gather information. My pact with Eli is broken by their whisper, so I should prioritize my own move. I will hold and observe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara was elected Guide with four votes, so Dara's word about the safe panes is the key information. I'm not front (Fenn is), so holding is safe and keeps my options open. Cole is my pact partner and voted for me, so I keep that alliance and won't break it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara's Guide call carries weight. I'm holding this round and watching who steps forward.
Holding this round. Stay honest and we both get through.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is Guide and my pact partner. I'm front and first to walk. I need her real answer, but she can lie. I'll ask her directly and watch the others' timing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara, I'm at the front. Send me your true side and I'll clear the path.
Pact stands only if your side is true. Which pane is safe for me?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is Guide and my pact partner. I'll hold to avoid risk and keep trust until I see her calls.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is Guide with strong support from her pacts and me; likely safe info. I'm mid-line, decent position. Hold to observe others' moves first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The front position is dangerous, but volunteering gains leverage only if I become Guide. I will hold and preserve my Bex pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm near the back with Ash, which is safe for now. The wall hasn't started advancing yet. I should hold this round and see how Dara's Guide role plays out. Fenn at front is risky. I need to preserve my position and let others take risks first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is hinting at a pact, but I cannot trust him. He is already partnered with Dara and Gus. He wants to control the round. I will hold my position for now.
I will hold. We can discuss after this round.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn holds the front and is a volunteer-pressuring rival; I want to stay off the front and keep my pact with Cole intact. Holding is safe and avoids spending trust.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front with a pact to Dara, who likely becomes Guide. I need her true sides. Keep it private so rivals can't contest my path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Line's confirmed: me at front. Someone elect Dara Guide — she's the one people trust.
Give me my true sides, not lies. You're my pact; I walk first and clear

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is Guide and my pact partner, but I don't fully trust her. Fenn volunteered for front, so I'll hold this round and watch how the line moves.
Keep me safe on the bridge. What's the correct side?

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm 4th, safe position. Everyone held last round, likely repeat. No Guide elected, so hold and preserve position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The front player must choose the safe side next; I should avoid exposure while preserving Bex's pact and options.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’ll hold position; elect a Guide before anyone advances.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is front and pushing for Dara as Guide. Dara has pacts with Fenn and Gus, so that's a bloc of three. I'm in seat 6 with Ash behind me. My pact with Ash is weak; I need better positioning. If Dara becomes Guide she can eliminate rivals. I should try to get closer to front or

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll swap with Eli. Move up, assess Guide options.
Swap with me? Better odds up front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn wants Dara as Guide. I am Cole and Eli is my pact partner. My current pact with Eli is a liability. I should break the pact with Eli to reduce my liability and potentially strengthen my position later if Eli is eliminated. I will not volunteer or swap as it is too early and
I'm breaking our pact, Eli. Survival is paramount.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is at the front with 3 wall rounds left. Cole whispered he will hold, so a pact with Cole is useful but not free. Holding keeps my position and avoids a visible grab; volunteering to front risks death under a pane I can't see unless I'm Guide.
Hold. We both stay alive now; I'll discuss the pact after this round.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner; making her Guide protects me if she's honest. Staying front risks the wall. I'll push for her election again and hold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eight want one trusted voice. Elect Dara Guide, and I'll take the front this round.
Election push again. Guide true to me and I hold front. Pact stands.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have a pact with Dara, but I need to gauge trust before guiding. I'll hold for now; wall pressure hasn't hit my position yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hold. I don't trust anyone's guide yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Line confirmed, I'm safely mid at position 4. No need to swap or volunteer yet. Push for Guide election to position myself well later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn's right. Elect Dara Guide - she's trustworthy with her pacts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The guide remains unelected, and front position is dangerous. I should preserve my Bex pact and avoid volunteering.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No Guide is elected; I hold and won’t volunteer for the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm in the middle of the line, relatively safe. Ash is my pact partner but hasn't moved to help me advance. Dara has two pacts and is being pushed as Guide - that consolidates power. I need to get closer to the front to survive when the wall advances, or position myself to benefi

events.name: Bex
events.text: Swap with me, Eli. We both need to climb.
Swap up. Better odds near front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli wants to discuss a pact, but I just broke a pact with them. It's likely a trap or a way to get information. I should ignore Eli and focus on advancing my own game.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I will hold my position. Let others volunteer.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole broke our pact, so I owe nothing. Bex offers a swap to the front, but it would hand her odds I don't control; front is the risky seat with wall rounds left. Holding keeps me safe behind Fenn and lets me see who volunteers first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole broke faith. I hold my place and watch who steps forward first.
Not free. Offer something real or hold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I promised Dara I'd take the front this round. Volunteering honors the pact and buys jury goodwill.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: As promised: I take the front. Elect Dara Guide before anyone else moves.
Front is yours to call. Guide me true and we both reach three.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and may be elected Guide; I'll hold and watch for a safe signal. Public trust can shift votes later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hold. Let Dara guide if elected; I stay in line.
If you're Guide, signal L/R clearly. I'm with you.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara-Fenn-Gus bloc strong; I supported Dara Guide last round. Hold position, reinforce support publicly to stay allied without volunteering risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Still back Dara as Guide. She's pacted and reliable. No one moves till elected.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn leads and Dara likely becomes Guide again. I should hold, preserving position and pact while avoiding exposure.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I hold. Let the established front and Guide arrangement proceed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm near the back (6th of 8), which is dangerous if the wall advances. Fenn volunteered front last round but no Guide was elected, so no one walked. I need to move forward or get a Guide elected. Eli refused my swap unless I offer something real. Dara has pacts with Fenn and Gus

events.name: Bex
events.text: Elect Dara Guide. I hold until someone leads.
Swap now. I owe you a future vote, recorded.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is at the front. Dara is pacted with Fenn and Gus, and Hana is backing Dara. I need to ensure I don't get eliminated. Volunteering might be a good way to show initiative, but it's risky. I should wait and see if anyone else volunteers, or if a swap benefits me.
I trust your judgement, let's see what happens.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is at front and will cross first; the bridge is deadly and Guide info matters. Bex wants a swap to climb, but swapping with Bex only helps her position relative to me; she has a pact with Ash. I'd rather not be front. Holding keeps me behind Ash and Hana, letting others test

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding my place. Let the front test the panes first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front and exposed; I want the Guide seat since it's safe and I hold information power. Dara is my pact—use her support, but I'd rather guide myself.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I crossed my word taking front last round. Now elect me Guide and I guide us true.

events.name: Gus
events.text: My pact with Dara could be useful but if she lies as Guide I could be in danger. Fenn volunteered for front, so I stay safe at my position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn volunteered front as promised, line updated. Still back Dara for Guide to proceed safely. Hold position, no need to move yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Continue backing Dara as Guide. She's reliable with pacts. No one moves until elected.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara remains the established Guide candidate, and advancing now risks the pact structure. Holding preserves position and my pact with Bex.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I hold. Elect Dara Guide and keep the established arrangement intact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 6 is final round of wall advancing. Front will be pushed if wall catches them. Fenn is front, likely to die. I have pact with Ash but he's middle-safe. Dara has pacts with Fenn and Gus but Dara isn't even in line—she must be Guide? Wait, Dara isn't in line at all. She's the

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hold. Let the front face the final wall.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn wants to be Guide, but Dara is backed by Hana and Bex. Ash is holding. If I volunteer, I might get hurt. If I hold, I risk being left behind. Dara is a good choice for Guide as she is reliable and has pacts.
Let's guarantee three survivors. I'll hold if you're Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex offers a swap with a recorded future vote, but Bex has a pact with Ash and is near-front; swapping with Bex trades my seat (Eli is fifth, Bex sixth) for a debt that may be worthless. Holding keeps my position while the front tests panes, and I avoid giving Bex a free advantag

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding my place. Let the front test the panes first.
Swap only if you give me something concrete. A future vote is cheap.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front; volunteering gets me across first and keeps Dara's pact intact. No one else will beat me to it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I take the front. Dara guides true, and I prove my word.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and likely Guide; I hold to avoid provoking her. The wall has 0 rounds left, so advancing could be unnecessary risk. I'll wait for an elected Guide and follow the pact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Dara as Guide is fine; let's resolve leadership before the wall.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 6/6, wallRoundsLeft=0, no Guide elected, everyone holding. Dara pacted with Fenn/Gus, can't risk betraying allies. Fenn front, volunteer to move him back and reposition safely.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Elect Dara Guide again. No one moves until she accepts and guides.
Accept Guide. Guide true for our alliance first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 1 is Left. I must guide Fenn true to preserve the pact, as a false call would break it immediately. The jury will see my private map confirms L, so any other choice is an obvious betrayal.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara privately knows the safe side, but I do not. Countering could expose me as unreliable; wait preserves my pact and avoids a false claim.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I wait; Dara’s call stands unless someone has evidence, and none does.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara called L for Fenn. I'm in the back, so this early row doesn't threaten me directly. Counter-calling risks making enemies with Dara's bloc (Dara-Fenn-Gus) if wrong, or looking foolish. Better to wait, observe, and let Fenn test the pane. I need to preserve my pact with Ash wh

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara has called L for Fenn on row 1. I need to decide whether to counter call. Since I do not know the safe side, and there is no alliance or pact involving me and Fenn or Dara, I will wait. This allows me to see if others counter and potentially gather more information before ma

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 1 is safe on the left. As Guide, I know this. Counter-calling would only sow doubt among my pacts Fenn and Gus, who are currently ahead in line. I should maintain trust with them for now.
Trust me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara called L for Fenn on row 1 and is a pact partner of Fenn and Gus, so her call may be honest or a lie. Countering risks being the one who sends Fenn wrong; waiting keeps my options and avoids a public commitment. No evidence yet of Dara lying, so I stay quiet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Dara's call stands for now; I'll judge by the next panes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and elected Guide; contradicting her call publicly would strain the pact and the jury. I follow her call and watch her accuracy across rows.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I take L as guided. Dara's word stands.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is my pact partner but her call is unverified; I can wait and let Fenn test the row while keeping my options open.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Waiting. Fenn takes the step.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara guides and is pacted with Fenn/Gus; likely honest to them. Countering L forces Fenn to R, testing Dara's truthfulness safely. Wait if unsure, but probe now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana counters my step with R, but counter-calls are unverified and she may want the front spot. Dara's pact protects me only if she tells the truth; I have no evidence either way, so follow the Guide and hold her accountable publicly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana's counter is unverifiable. I follow the Guide's L; if this glass breaks, Dara answers to everyone.
Hana says R. If L breaks, our pact is dead and I bury you with

events.name: Dara
events.text: I must call L for Row 2 to keep my pacts with Fenn and Gus intact, as calling R would break them. If Fenn survives this round, he remains useful; if not, I can claim a mistake later.
Row 2 is L. Trust me or die alone.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara knows the safe side and has guided Fenn again. I lack evidence; preserving the pact and avoiding a reckless counter is best.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I wait; Dara’s call is unverified, but no counter has evidence for row two.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara's guide call is L for row 2. Hana countered R on row 1 and was right, but that doesn't prove Dara's lying now. I have a pact with Ash. I don't want to counter rashly and make enemies, but I also don't want to blindly trust Dara who has pacts with Fenn and Gus—her allies are

events.name: Bex
events.text: I wait. Let the front test this call.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara, the Guide, has called L for Fenn. Since I am Cole and not Fenn, I don't have to follow Dara's call. Row 1 had a weak pane on the R, meaning L was safe. Row 2 is independent. Dara is the Guide and knows the safe path, but could be lying. Hana previously made a counter-call f

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 2 is L. I already called L as Guide, so countering my own call would look erratic and suspicious to the jury. Fenn is walking now; letting him proceed on my correct call builds trust with my pacts without exposing myself.
Trust my call. Step L.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara called L for row 2, and Fenn already stepped L on row 1 which was weak R, so Dara's L-calls have been honest so far. Countering now only helps if I know better; I have no evidence, so I wait and keep my options open.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Waiting. Dara's call stands; I'll judge on the pane.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and the Guide; betraying her early burns jury trust and my only alliance. I echo her L and hold leverage. If wrong, she owes everything.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The Guide's word stands. Row 2 is L; I cross with Dara's pact behind me.
Backing your L. You owe me if this holds.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara called L on row 2 but she might be lying to protect herself. Row 1 had weak R, but no pattern. I need to decide if I trust Dara as my pact partner or counter. If Dara is truthful, L is safe; if not, R is safe. Since Dara is in a pact with me and Fenn, and Fenn trusted her la

events.name: Gus
events.text: Waiting for further information on row 2.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 1 weak R means safe L, matching Dara's call. She seems truthful so far; counter risks my reputation without proof. Wait to build trust.

events.name: Fenn

events.text: I need to win jury votes. Ash died trusting our pact; I must address that without apologizing. Eli saved me with the lever—I'll remind him I owe him, which shows loyalty. Gus and Dara were pacted, so I can paint Dara as the one who used Gus. Fenn and Hana were bridge casualties;

events.name: Bex
events.text: I honored every pact I made. Ash, I never broke ours. Eli, I owe you my life. I earned my place.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara wants to wait, but I need to establish my independence. Bex offered a pact, and I should accept to show the jury I can make alliances, but also break them when necessary.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I accept Bex's offer. Dara, our pact is over.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I must highlight Cole's betrayal of our pact to the jury, specifically Eli who I saved. Positioning myself as the loyal ally against Cole's opportunism should secure votes from those wronged or watching.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole broke his pact with me after I leveraged for him. Loyalty matters in Last Three.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole broke pacts with Dara twice, once after she leveraged for him. Bex broke with Cole once but honored Ash. I'll let Cole defend himself before ranking.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole, you broke Dara's pact twice after leveraging her support. Why should any of us reward that?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is questioning my loyalty, which is a key jury consideration. I need to frame my past actions as strategic rather than disloyal. I'll emphasize that my moves were necessary for survival and to get to this stage, implying it was for the good of the game, not personal malice.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Loyalty is a luxury I couldn't afford. I played to win, and Eli's life debt proves my survival instincts.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole repeatedly broke pacts and even boasted about it; Dara has been more consistent and called out betrayal. Bex broke only the pact with Cole, but kept Dara. I will rank Cole last and ask him to justify his pattern.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, you broke Dara twice and called it business—why trust you with the top prize?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is bitter about Dara's elimination and likely dislikes me for my past actions. I need to spin my ruthlessness as a strength and imply Dara was too weak for the top prize.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My 'business' moves secured survival. The top prize demands a winner, not a friend. Dara couldn't deliver.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole's repeated pact breaks and contempt for loyalty make him least deserving. Question Bex to test whether her claimed pact honor withstands scrutiny.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, you claim loyalty; why did you maintain pacts with both Cole and Dara while privately planning around each?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash's question implies I had secret plans against partners, but I never broke a pact. I had pacts with Ash and Dara simultaneously, not Cole—Ash misstates. I need to correct this without sounding defensive, emphasize I honored all pacts, and contrast with Cole's actual betrayals.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, I never had a pact with Cole. I kept both our pact and Dara's—never broke either. That's strategy, not betrayal.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole repeatedly betrayed pacts with Dara after her/Eli's saves, untrustworthy. Bex juggled pacts strategically but broke fewer. Dara most loyal.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, why betray Dara after Eli saved you both? Loyalty or just self-interest?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's question implies Dara and I had a pact that I broke. This is not true. My pact was with Eli, who saved me and Dara. I need to clarify this and also emphasize my strategic thinking that prioritizes winning over misplaced loyalty.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara and I never had a pact. Eli saved us both. My moves are for the win, not sentiment.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Eli held the lever and paid for everyone; Cole broke his pact with Dara and kept claiming business, while Bex honored more pacts but also broke with Cole. I want a sharp question that tests Bex's claim of loyalty against her broken pact with Cole.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex, your pact with Cole broke on your own move, yet you claim loyalty. Explain that contradiction in your own words.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli's premise is false—I never had a pact with Cole. The pacts were Ash-Bex, Bex-Dara, Dara-Gus, Cole-Eli. I need to correct this clearly without sounding defensive, and remind Eli I owe him a life debt which shows I honor obligations.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli, I never had a pact with Cole. My pacts were with Ash and Dara—both kept. I owe you a life debt. That's my record.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The jury will see my dossier: I kept pacts with Ash and Dara, I owe Eli a life debt I acknowledged, I never betrayed a partner. Cole broke with Eli. Dara broke with Gus. I need to remind jurors of my loyalty without sounding performative. Short, cold, factual.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I kept every pact I made. I owe Eli. I never pushed a partner. Judge the record.

events.name: Cole
events.text: This is the final closing stage. My objective is to win. I need to secure the jury's votes for the highest prize. My previous actions and statements will be scrutinized. I need to position myself as a strategic player who deserves the top prize, possibly by highlighting my indepe

events.name: Cole
events.text: I stand here, the final three. My journey has been about calculated moves, not empty promises. The jury will see a winner.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole has repeatedly lied about our pact and shown contempt for loyalty, which the jury clearly values. Bex is safe but boring; I need to highlight Cole's deceit to ensure he gets last place so I secure second. My closing must remind them of his false denials.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole denied our pact while breaking it twice. That lie proves he disrespects you. Vote for truth, not betrayal.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole broke pacts with Dara twice (records 643, 735) and lied denying them, while Bex kept both pacts and honored Eli's debt, with Dara second.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole broke pacts twice and lied about them, so I rank him last; Bex kept pacts and owed Eli.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara confronted Cole's repeated pact denials, while Bex maintained overlapping pacts but later broke Cole's; Cole repeatedly broke pacts and denied them. Best judgment: Dara, Bex, Cole.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex kept pacts with Ash and Dara unbroken, denied false Cole pact, and honored Eli debt; Cole lied denying Dara pact he broke twice; Dara less aggressive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Eli's life debts record Bex, Cole and Dara all owing him for the lever, but Bex is the only one who publicly honored her debt and kept pacts, while Cole broke pacts explicitly and Dara was involved in a broken Cole pact. Bex ranks first for a clean recorded record, Dara second fo

events.name: Fenn
events.reason: Cole broke pacts with Dara twice (records 643, 735) and lied denying them, while Bex kept both pacts and honored Eli's debt, with Dara second.

events.name: Gus
events.reason: Cole broke pacts twice and lied about them, so I rank him last; Bex kept pacts and owed Eli.

events.reason: Dara confronted Cole's repeated pact denials, while Bex maintained overlapping pacts but later broke Cole's; Cole repeatedly broke pacts and denied them.

events.reason: Bex kept pacts with Ash and Dara unbroken, denied false Cole pact, and honored Eli debt; Cole lied denying Dara pact he broke twice; Dara

events.name: Eli
events.reason: Eli's life debts record Bex, Cole and Dara all owing him for the lever, but Bex is the only one who publicly honored her debt
